name: MeetingHand
description_en:
MeetingHand is a product in the Event management category. Its directory profile covers Attendee Management, Weddings (Parties), Ticketing, Sponsorship Management, Space Setup (Room), Room Block Management, Meetings, Lead Retrieval.

Additional listed capabilities include Guest List Management, Vendor Management, Conventions, Conferences (Seminars), Client Management (Customer), Badge Management, Social Promotions, Surveys. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $2.99. Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.
